messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high token-latency spike detected for route /v1/generate (p95 > 1200ms) — SLO breach. Incident severity: P2. Pager duty notified.

Priya S: picking this up — oncall here. Looking at metrics now.

Priya S: top 3 regions showing errors: us-west1, eu-central. Error mix is 502s and timeouts.

Marco P: rolling a warm node pool now, increasing pool size by 20%.

Priya S: temporary mitigation: route traffic to fallback model variant rdx-small in us-east to reduce latency. Will monitor.

Jenna L: noted increased qps from a single client (acct-927). Can we rate-limit them if impact persists?

Priya S: yes, applying per-customer throttle for acct-927 now.

Ops Runbot: command executed: `rdw scale-pool --pool inference-a --delta 4` — success.

Priya S: latency dropped to p95=800ms after scale+fallback. Customer errors decreased. Still above SLO of 500ms.

Alice M: assigning post-incident review. Can we schedule postmortem tomorrow? I can host at 11:00am PDT.

Priya S: agreed. I'll draft timeline and impact. Need owner for remediation: Marco P volunteers for alert tuning + runbook; Alice M will own customer comms.

Marco P: opening tickets: INFR-4123 (alert tune), SRE-918 (runbook + automation), PM-2022 (customer throttle policy). I'll link in thread when created.

Priya S: created initial incident timeline in the incident doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/1745501234 — please add notes.

Jenna L: can we reduce duplicate pages? We got pagerduty + slack duplicate alerts. Suggest change to paging rule: only page on sustained p95>700ms for 3m, not single spike.

Alice M: +1. Also add a noise-suppression rule for client-account-specific spikes: only page at account-level if >5% global traffic.

Marco P: proposed alert changes:
```
- metric: http_p95_latency
- scope: global
- threshold: 700ms
- duration: 3m
- exemptions: accounts with >5% of traffic will get separate account alert
```

Priya S: posting proposed timeline for tomorrow's postmortem (11:00 PDT): 15m timeline, 20m root-cause, 10m action items. Invite: #eng, #eng-sre, product.

incident-bot: :calendar: Postmortem meeting created: https://meet.internal/pm-1745501234

Marco P: tickets created: INFR-4123 (https://jira.internal/browse/INFR-4123), SRE-918 (https://jira.internal/browse/SRE-918)

Alice M: I've drafted a customer note for acct-927. Will send after postmortem confirmation. /cc @sales

Priya S: runbook updates needed: add section on fallback model routing and quick throttle for noisy tenants. Assigning to Marco P.

Marco P: ETA for runbook + automation: EOD +2 days. Will link PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/501

Jenna L: follow-up action: review SLOs for chat vs. streaming endpoints. Some of our alerts tuned for text-gen only.

Priya S: assigning follow-ups. Action items summarized in thread:
- Marco P: tune paging rules + create automation (INFR-4123)
- Marco P: update runbook + PR (SRE-918)
- Alice M: customer comms for acct-927
- Jenna L: SLO review for endpoint types
- Priya S: postmortem doc + timeline

Alice M: tiny ask — add context about recent deploy 1745 that landed 45m before incident. DeployBot, any signal?

DeployBot: Deploy 1745 -> models-service -> success. No immediate errors flagged during deploy window.

Priya S: closing notes: current status stable, routing in fallback. Postmortem scheduled. I'll ping everyone an hour before meeting. :white_check_mark:

Marco P: adding runbook checklist item: 'If 502s, check model variant cache eviction' — saved.

Jenna L: thanks team. Reactions: :thumbsup: :coffee:
